note: Adapted from the German description of Holmgren 1913. The original reads Calotermes (Glyptotermes) dentatus Hav.; in 1913 only soldiers and immatures were available, and the alate section quotes the original English description of Haviland 1898, page 375, which this entry records as a secondary source; in Haviland 1898 that alate description belongs to another group of the genus Calotermes (the original species name is Termes dentatus), and Holmgren assigned it to Glyptotermes on the basis of its soldier. Type locality Sarawak, Borneo.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier: head nearly quadrate, almost twice as long as wide (the original says 'nearly twice as long as wide'), almost cylindrical, the frons strongly inclined and bilobed; labrum extending beyond half of the mandibles; mandibles rather short and stout; antennae 10-segmented, with a trace of an 11th segment. Pronotum about as wide as the head, the anterior margin strongly concave, the sides only slightly narrowed posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Holmgren notes that G. hozawai is the species closest to this one.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: (Quoted from the original description of Haviland 1898, page 375.) Female body length 4.5 mm; ocelli touching the compound eyes; antennae 11-segmented; pronotum kidney-shaped; wings 4.3 mm long, 1.1 mm wide; costal area narrow and veinless, the media closely applied to the subcosta along its whole length; legs not reaching the end of the abdomen; 7th sternite almost as long as wide.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: (The original notes that this may be a small soldier.) Head yellow-red, tinged with brown anteriorly; mandibles reddish brown, becoming black towards the apex; body yellowish at the pronotum, otherwise whitish with the grey intestinal contents showing through. Vestiture very sparse. Head nearly quadrate, almost twice as long as wide, almost cylindrical; frons strongly inclined, bilobed; labrum extending beyond half of the mandibles; mandibles rather short and stout; antennae 10-segmented, with a trace of an 11th segment. Pronotum about as wide as the head, the anterior margin strongly concave, the sides only slightly narrowed posteriorly, the posterior margin slightly concave in the middle. Measurements (mm): body length 5, head length with mandibles 2.00, head length without mandibles 1.67, head width 0.91, pronotal width 0.84, pronotal length 0.48.

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Another pair of immatures with wing pads: very long and narrow, the brown intestinal contents showing through the body wall.
